commitment_entries_one_parent.name: commitment_entries_one_parent
commitment_entries_one_parent.value:
(
        ("commitment_entries"."project_year_allocation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "commitment_entries"."recurring_ops_item_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("commitment_entries"."project_year_allocation_id" IS NULL AND "commitment_entries"."recurring_ops_item_id" IS NOT NULL)
      )

opening_balance_reconciliations_controls.name: opening_balance_reconciliations_controls_non_negative
opening_balance_reconciliations_controls.value:
"opening_balance_reconciliations"."control_envelope_capex" >= 0
        AND "opening_balance_reconciliations"."control_envelope_opex" >= 0
        AND "opening_balance_reconciliations"."control_prior_program_budget_used_capex" >= 0
        AND "opening_balance_reconciliations"."control_prior_program_budget_used_opex" >= 0
        AND "opening_balance_reconciliations"."control_program_budgets" >= 0
        AND "opening_balance_reconciliations"."control_program_carry_in" >= 0
        AND "opening_balance_reconciliations"."control_project_opening_allocated" >= 0
        AND "opening_balance_reconciliations"."control_project_opening_committed" >= 0
        AND "opening_balance_reconciliations"."control_project_opening_spent" >= 0
        AND "opening_balance_reconciliations"."control_project_full_life_allocated" >= 0

spend_entries_one_parent.name: spend_entries_one_parent
spend_entries_one_parent.value:
(
        ("spend_entries"."project_year_allocation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "spend_entries"."recurring_ops_item_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("spend_entries"."project_year_allocation_id" IS NULL AND "spend_entries"."recurring_ops_item_id" IS NOT NULL)
      )
